items.e: The meat of the red **heifer is** susceptible to **contracting ritual impurity of food,** despite the fact that it is prohibited to derive benefit from such meat, **since it had a time when it was fit** for consumption.
items.o: פָּרָה – מְטַמֵּא טוּמְאַת אוֹכָלִין, הוֹאִיל וְהָיְתָה לָהּ שְׁעַת הַכּוֹשֶׁר.
